branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: Primina and Schärdinger Sommerbutter are two butter brands of the Schärdinger dairy in Upper Austria. Primina, a premium butter, was introduced in the early 1970s; Sommerbutter was made at the Taufkirchen an der Pram plant.

sources.text: The two brands and their plant, from these.
